Vendored static assets in this directory:
  - xterm.js            from @xterm/xterm@6.0.0            (lib/xterm.js,  UMD build)
  - xterm.css           from @xterm/xterm@6.0.0             (css/xterm.css)
  - xterm-addon-fit.js  from @xterm/addon-fit@0.11.0        (lib/addon-fit.js, UMD build)

Fetched one-time via `npm pack <pkg> --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` and copied here
as static files (no npm dependency tree, no CDN, no node_modules committed). Source:
https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js

Both packages are MIT licensed. License texts below, copied verbatim from each package's
LICENSE file in the fetched tarball.
